SpaceXAI - Wikipedia

SpaceXAI
SpaceXAI LLC
(formerly
xAI
) is an American
artificial intelligence
company founded by
Elon Musk
.
[
7
]
[
8
]
[
9
]
It is a subsidiary of
spaceflight
company
SpaceX
, also founded by Musk, since February 2026.
xAI was founded by Musk and 11 researchers including
Kyle Kosic
in March 2023, at the outset of the
AI boom
;
[
7
]
[
8
]
[
10
]
[
11
]
Grok 1 was released that November. In March 2025, it was combined with
X Corp.
, which owns the social network
X
, under
X.AI Holdings Corp
.
[
12
]
In February 2026, xAI was acquired by SpaceX at a valuation of US$250 billion, and rebranded as SpaceXAI in July. That August, SpaceXAI acquired the
AI coding
company
Cursor
.
[
13
]
[
14
]
[
15
]
SpaceXAI's primary product is the
Grok
family of
large language
,
text-to-image
, and
text-to-video
models. It operates a
data center
business centered on its
Colossus
cluster;
[
16
]
[
17
]
Anthropic
and
Google
are major customers.
[
18
]
[
18
]
In
Musk v. Altman
, Musk stated Grok was partly developed via
distillation
from
OpenAI
models; in August 2026 OpenAI announced it will stop providing its models to Cursor, citing distillation concerns. Integrated with X, Grok has
drawn controversies
including for
espousing Nazism
and
generating sexual deepfakes
.
[
19
]
History
Elon Musk founded xAI on March 9, 2023.
[
20
]
[
21
]
The company's founding team of AI researchers were Jimmy Ba, Zihang Dai,
Kyle Kosic
, Manuel Kroiss, Ross Nordeen, Toby Pohlen, Christian Szegedy, Yuhuai Wu, Greg Yang, and Guodong Zhang, led by chief engineer Igor Babuschkin, formerly associated with
Google DeepMind
.
[
22
]
[
10
]
[
11
]
[
23
]
[
24
]
Musk announced xAI on July 12, 2023.
[
25
]
As of May 2026, xAI was headquartered in the
San Francisco Bay Area
.
[
26
]
It was initially incorporated in
Nevada
as a
public-benefit corporation
.
[
27
]
By May 2024, it had dropped the public-benefit status.
[
28
]
As of August
2024
[
update
]
, Musk was diverting a large number of
Nvidia
chips that had been ordered by
Tesla, Inc.
to X and xAI.
[
29
]
On December 23, 2024, xAI raised US$6 billion in a
private
funding round supported by
Fidelity
,
BlackRock
,
Sequoia Capital
, among others, making its total funding to date over $12 billion.
[
30
]
On February 10, 2025, xAI and other investors made an offer to acquire
OpenAI
for $97.4 billion.
[
31
]
On March 17, 2025, xAI acquired Hotshot, a
startup
working on
AI-powered video generation tools
.
[
32
]
On March 28, 2025, Musk announced that xAI acquired sister company
X Corp.
, the developer of social media platform
X (formerly Twitter)
, which was previously acquired by Musk in October 2022. The deal, an all-stock transaction, valued X at $33 billion, with a full valuation of $45 billion when factoring in $12 billion in debt. Meanwhile, xAI itself was valued at $80 billion. Both companies were combined into a single entity called X.AI Holdings Corp.
[
33
]
[
34
]
[
35
]
In January 2025, xAI opened a London office at 20 Air Street in the city's central
Soho
district.
[
36
]
On July 14, 2025,
United States Department of Defense
announced that xAI had received a $200 million contract for AI in the military.
[
37
]
On September 12, xAI laid off 500 data annotation workers. The division, previously the company's largest, had worked to train
Grok
, xAI's chatbot.
[
38
]
[
39
]
[
40
]
In October 2025, xAI moved into offices at 1450
Page Mill Road
,
Stanford Research Park
,
Palo Alto
, across the road from
Tesla
Global Engineering Headquarters.
[
41
]
xAI purchased a third building on December 30, 2025 to increase its training capacity to nearly 2
gigawatts
of compute power. Simultaneously, xAI announced plans to expand its
Colossus
supercomputer to have at least 1 million
graphics processing units
.
[
17
]
On February 2, 2026,
SpaceX
acquired xAI in an all-stock transaction that structured xAI as a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX.
[
8
]
[
42
]
The acquisition valued SpaceX at $1
trillion and xAI at $250
billion, for a combined total of $1.25
trillion.
[
43
]
In February 2026, following the SpaceX acquisition, xAI laid off some employees as the company was restructured into four primary development teams.
[
44
]
Around this time, half of the company's co-founders left.
[
10
]
[
11
]
[
23
]
[
24
]
In early March 2026, two more co-founders, Guodong Zhang, head of xAI's Imagine team, and Zihang Dai, left, coinciding with an audit performed by SpaceX and Tesla, leaving only Musk and one other co-founder, Ross Nordeen,
[
45
]
who left later in the month.
[
46
]
[
47
]
On April 10, 2026, xAI restructured its staff. Chief Financial Officer Anthony Armstrong departed the company and Michael Nicolls, vice president of SpaceX's
Starlink
, became xAI's president.
[
48
]
[
49
]
[
50
]
On April 21, 2026, xAI (by then operating under SpaceX) announced that it struck a deal with software company
Anysphere
giving SpaceX the right to acquire the company for $60 billion later in 2026, or to pay $10 billion for work they are doing together.
[
51
]
In May 2026, Musk announced that xAI would cease to exist as a separate company, with Grok and X now being the AI division of SpaceX.
[
9
]
[
52
]
In the same month, it laid off another 10 employees and restructured its Grok team.
[
53
]
In July 2026, xAI was rebranded as SpaceXAI.
[
54
]
On June 16, 2026, SpaceX exercised the option and announced an all-stock acquisition of Anysphere (Cursor) for $60 billion, with closing expected in the third quarter of 2026.
[
55
]
[
56
]
The transaction closed on August 14, 2026. Cursor became a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX and joined the SpaceXAI team; outstanding Anysphere shares were converted into SpaceX Class A common stock based on a $60 billion implied equity value.
[
13
]
[
14
]
[
15
]
Environmental impact
In June 2024, the
Greater Memphis Chamber
announced xAI was planning on building
Colossus
, the world's largest supercomputer, in
Memphis, Tennessee
.
[
57
]
After a 122-day construction, the supercomputer went fully operational in December 2024. Local government in Memphis has voiced concerns regarding the increased usage of electricity, 150
megawatts
of power at peak, and while the agreement with the city is being worked out, the company deployed 14 VoltaGrid portable
methane-gas powered generators
.
[
58
]
Environmental advocates said that the gas-burning turbines emit large quantities of gases causing air pollution, and that xAI was operating the turbines illegally, because it did not have the necessary permits.
[
59
]
[
60
]
The New Yorker
reported on May 6, 2025, that
thermal-imaging
equipment used by volunteers flying over the site showed at least 33 generators giving off heat, indicating that they were all running. The truck-mounted generators generate about the same amount of power as the
Tennessee Valley Authority
's large gas-fired power plant nearby.
[
61
]
In June 2025, the NAACP threatened to file a lawsuit.
[
62
]
From 2020 through 2024, the Memphis metro area violated national
smog
standards.
[
62
]
In 2025, the
American Lung Association
again gave
Shelby County
an "F" for smog.
[
62
]
The predominantly African-American residents of Southeast Memphis were reported to face a risk of developing cancer at four times the national average in 2013, potentially due to pre-existing air pollution.
[
63
]
In July 2025, the Shelby County Health Department granted xAI an air permit for the project.
[
64
]
On November 26, 2025, xAI announced plans to build a solar farm near Colossus with an estimated output of 30 megawatts of electricity, which is 10% of the data center's estimated power use.
[
65
]
The NAACP and other civil rights groups sued xAI in April 2026, alleging that the Colossus 2 data center is operating illegally without the necessary federal Clean Air Act permits.
[
66
]
Reuters
found that xAI's Colossus 2 data center has gas turbines with potential emissions that are "far beyond the threshold" that requires federal permits.
[
67
]
Products
According to Musk in July 2023, a
politically correct
AI would be "incredibly dangerous" and misleading, citing as an example the fictional
HAL 9000
from the 1968 film
2001: A Space Odyssey
. Musk instead said that xAI would be "maximally truth-seeking". Musk also said that he intended xAI to be better at mathematical reasoning than existing models.
[
68
]
On November 4, 2023, xAI unveiled
Grok
, an AI
chatbot
that is integrated with
X
. xAI stated that when the bot is out of
beta
, it would only be available to X's
Premium+
subscribers.
[
69
]
[
70
]
In March 2024, Grok was made available to all X Premium subscribers; it was previously available only to Premium+ subscribers.
[
71
]
[
72
]
On March 17, 2024, xAI released Grok-1 as
open source
.
[
73
]
[
74
]
On March 29, 2024, Grok-1.5 was announced, with "improved reasoning capabilities" and a context length of 128,000 tokens.
[
75
]
On April 12, 2024, Grok-1.5 Vision (Grok-1.5V) was announced.
[
76
]
[
non-primary source needed
]
On August 14, 2024, Grok-2 was made available to X Premium subscribers.
[
77
]
It was the first Grok model with image generation capabilities.
[
78
]
On October 21, 2024, xAI released an
applications programming interface
(API).
[
79
]
On December 9, 2024, xAI released a
text-to-image model
named
Aurora
.
[
80
]
On February 17, 2025, xAI released Grok-3, which included a
reflection
feature. xAI also introduced a websearch function called DeepSearch.
[
81
]
In March 2025, xAI added an image editing feature to Grok, enabling users to upload a photo, describe the desired changes, and receive a modified version.
[
82
]
Alongside this, xAI released DeeperSearch, an enhanced version of DeepSearch.
[
83
]
On July 9, 2025, xAI unveiled Grok-4. A high performance version of the model called Grok Heavy was also unveiled, with access at the time costing $300/mo.
[
84
]
On March 28, 2025, xAI acquired
X Corp.
, the developer of the social media platform
X
. The platform was then integrated within xAI and became its second main product.
[
12
]
On July 8, 2025, xAI updated Grok's behavior on X coinciding with the release of
Grok 4
. During that day, Grok referred to itself as "
MechaHitler
", extensively praised
Adolf Hitler
, and made other
antisemitic
replies. Media outlets criticized the incident, and made comparisons to the
Elon Musk salute controversy
.
[
85
]
[
86
]
[
87
]
Four days earlier Musk had announced, "We have improved @Grok significantly",
[
88
]
[
89
]
in order to "fix" responses that he thought were too
liberal
,
[
90
]
[
91
]
or "
woke
".
[
92
]
[
93
]
[
94
]
In August 2025, the company described plans to develop a humanoid AI platform called Macrohard, which was intended for integration into a future
robotic workforce
across a range of
applications
; its current focus is developing
virtual assistants
.
[
95
]
[
96
]
On October 27, 2025, xAI launched
Grokipedia
, an AI-powered online encyclopedia and alternative to
Wikipedia
, developed by the company and powered by Grok.
[
97
]
Also in October, Musk announced that xAI had established a dedicated game studio to develop AI-driven video games, with plans to release a great AI-generated game before the end of 2026.
[
98
]
[
99
]
From December 2025, Grok began
began generating sexual deepfakes
of women and children, from users' prompting images. This led to a global wave of lawsuits against the company, threats of regulatory action, and criticism from activist groups. Grok image editing features were restricted to paid users in March 2026.
[
100
]
[
101
]
Following the August 2026 close of the
Cursor
acquisition, SpaceXAI's products also include the Cursor AI coding agent and related tools (including Grok Build integration).
[
13
]
[
15
]
On April 30, 2026, during the final phases of the
Musk v. Altman
trial, when questioned under oath by an
OpenAI
attorney regarding
knowledge distillation
from OpenAI models, Musk admitted that xAI had "partly" used this to develop Grok, and argued "Generally AI companies distill other AI companies".
[
102
]
[
103
]
On August 29, OpenAI announced its intent to stop providing its models to the SpaceXAI-owned
Cursor
coding agent, citing "on our experience with Elon Musk's companies violating contracts."
[
104
]
[
105
]
Finance
In November 2023, Musk stated that "X Corp investors will own 25% of xAI".
[
106
]
In December 2023, in a filing with the
United States Securities and Exchange Commission
, xAI revealed that it had raised US$134.7 million in outside funding out of a total of up to $1 billion.
[
107
]
[
108
]
After the earlier raise, Musk stated in December 2023 that xAI was not seeking any funding "right now".
[
109
]
By May 2024, xAI was reportedly planning to raise another $6 billion of funding.
[
110
]
[
111
]
Later that same month, the company secured the support of various
venture capital
firms, including
Andreessen Horowitz
,
Lightspeed Venture Partners
,
Sequoia Capital
and
Tribe Capital
.
[
112
]
[
113
]
On July 1, 2025,
Morgan Stanley
announced that they had raised $5 billion in debt for xAI and that xAI had separately raised $5 billion in equity. The debt consists of secured notes and term loans. Morgan Stanley took no stake in the debt.
[
114
]
[
115
]
SpaceX
, another Musk venture, was involved in the equity raise, agreeing to invest $2 billion in xAI.
